name: Fusion Data Hub
description: Fusion Data Hub, utilizing Fabric Real-Time Intelligence seamlessly moves your operational (OT) data, including near real time streaming, historical, metadata and hierarchical data from Historian systems and similar into Microsoft Fabric Onelake and prepares your data for Industrial Analytics and AI transformations.Using Fusion's solution on Fabric customers can ingest their OT(Operational) data from on-prem or the Cloud into Fabric and unify with their IT data stored in ERP, MES, SCM and other business systems all in OneLake to unlock actionable insights supporting a wide range of personas from engineers to executives in the organization.Key use-cases"1. Visualizations via Fusion or PowerBI2. Industrial analytics3. AI/ML with ready to use data in OneLake.
